entries.what: downloads a prebuilt libvips from GitHub releases when it installs
entries.fix: Upgrade sharp to 0.33 or later, which installs its native parts as npm packages (@img/sharp-*) from the npm registry.
entries.source: sharp installation documentation; sharp 0.33.0 release notes (prebuilt binaries moved to npm packages); denial report of a real build, 2026-10-26

entries.what: downloads a browser build from Google's storage when it installs
entries.fix: Set PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true for the install and use a browser from the base image's packages, or depend on puppeteer-core, which downloads nothing.
entries.source: Puppeteer configuration guide (environment variables) and installation notes

entries.what: downloads Prisma engine binaries when it installs
entries.fix: Prisma engines come from binaries.prisma.sh; an organization administrator can add binaries.prisma.sh:443 as an egress destination, or point PRISMA_ENGINES_MIRROR at a mirror the policy allows.
entries.source: Prisma documentation: engines, environment variables reference (PRISMA_ENGINES_MIRROR)

entries.what: downloads a compiled binding from GitHub releases when it installs, and compiles from source when that fails
entries.fix: node-sass is deprecated; replace it with the sass package (Dart Sass), which is plain JavaScript and downloads nothing.
entries.source: node-sass README (binary download, SASS_BINARY_SITE) and its deprecation notice

entries.what: downloads a prebuilt binary from GitHub releases when it installs, and compiles from source (Node.js headers from nodejs.org, Python, make and a C++ compiler) when that fails
entries.fix: Upgrade bcrypt to 6.0 or later, which ships its prebuilt binaries inside the npm package, or use bcryptjs.
entries.source: bcrypt README (node-pre-gyp, fallback build requirements) and 6.0.0 release notes (prebuildify)

entries.what: downloads a prebuilt binary from GitHub releases when it installs (prebuild-install), and compiles from source (Node.js headers from nodejs.org, Python, make and a C++ compiler) when that fails
entries.fix: An organization administrator can add the GitHub release hosts as egress destinations; otherwise install python3, make and g++ in the image and allow the nodejs-dist preset so the source build works.

entries.what: downloads a prebuilt binary from GitHub releases when it installs, and compiles from source when that fails
entries.fix: An organization administrator can add the GitHub release hosts as egress destinations; otherwise install python3, make and g++ in the image and allow the nodejs-dist preset so the source build works.

entries.what: downloads a prebuilt binary from GitHub releases when it installs, and compiles from source, which needs Cairo and Pango development packages, when that fails
entries.fix: An organization administrator can add the GitHub release hosts as egress destinations; otherwise install the Cairo, Pango and build packages the canvas README lists and allow the nodejs-dist preset.

entries.what: downloads the Cypress application when it installs
entries.fix: Set CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY=0 for image builds that do not run Cypress, or keep cypress in devDependencies and install with --omit=dev.
entries.source: Cypress documentation: advanced installation (CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY, download mirror)

entries.what: downloads the Electron binary from GitHub releases when it installs
entries.fix: Set ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 for the install, or keep electron in devDependencies and install with --omit=dev.

entries.what: downloads browsers from the Playwright CDN
entries.fix: An organization administrator can add the Playwright download hosts as egress destinations, or point PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST at a mirror the policy allows. Alternatively base the image on one that already contains the browsers.

entries.what: downloads Prisma engine binaries when they are missing
entries.fix: An organization administrator can add binaries.prisma.sh:443 as an egress destination, or point PRISMA_ENGINES_MIRROR at a mirror the policy allows.
entries.source: Prisma documentation: engines, environment variables reference

entries.fix: An organization administrator can add the Cypress download hosts as egress destinations, or set CYPRESS_DOWNLOAD_MIRROR to a mirror the policy allows.

entries.what: downloads a browser build from Google's storage
entries.fix: An organization administrator can add storage.googleapis.com:443 as an egress destination, or use a browser from the base image's packages.
